page.overview:
What is Chuni Chuni no Mi?

The Chuni Chuni no Mi is a non-canon Paramecia-type Devil Fruit that allows the user to "tune" abilities and powers, making the user a . It was eaten by Yehudi.

The main strength of this fruit is that it allows the user to tune, i.e. increase or decrease the abilities and powers of people by firing beams known as or In addition, it is possible to make finer and stronger adjustments by touching the target directly. The user can also adjust their own power as well as the environment. Those affected by one of the beams will have an up or down arrow on the back.

Additionally, touching someone and using the fruit's abilities greatly boosts its strength. This boost in strength was enough to bring Shirotsu from unable to harm Luffy to being capable of seriously fighting him. The tuning of the Chuni Chuni no Mi is also not limited to living beings, as Yehudi was capable of manipulating the energy of a volcano.

The effects of the Chuni Chuni no Mi can be washed off with water. No other weaknesses are known outside the standard Devil Fruit weaknesses.
